order: First ready task in this array; serialize shared-file writers. A later independent task may proceed only when an earlier one is genuinely blocked.

tasks.title: Characterize current HEAD without restarting the previous project
tasks.problem: The previous ledger reports 115 Rust tests and 20 frontend tests, but these were not independently rerun in this audit. Latest CI job never received a runner and has no steps. Baseline claims are not release proof.
changes: Record git status, branch, HEAD and diff from audit_base. Do not reset or stash user edits. Compare only newly changed paths, not every historical plan.

Generate full tracked-file metadata with the helper; classify source/test/config/document/generated/binary paths. Metadata does not confer semantic review. Assign remaining source review to the owning packet; read each changed file and callers before editing.

Run available baseline commands once. Record exit codes, named environment, test counts, skipped tests and separate infrastructure blockers. Do not change production code just to satisfy runner provisioning.
acceptance: Baseline report and precise unavailable checks exist; no false pass. R00 may be verified as a characterization task even when native tests are unavailable, provided they remain explicit release blockers.
Existing journey, permission, context, artifact and extraction-history tests are retained. No destructive cleanup.
tests: python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_vislex_plan.py
python scripts/vislex_plan.py check
npm ci; npm test; npm run build (run separately and record each)
cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
cargo check --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features desktop

tasks.title: Repair duplicate transcript backup entries through the real publisher
tasks.problem: transcription::publish registers TXT/JSON/SRT paths in artifacts. prepare_backup adds those registered paths, then adds them again by scanning working/transcripts. restore uses exclusive create and refuses the duplicate. The new test writes unregistered transcript files and misses this production shape.
changes: First call actual transcription::publish with a minimal synthetic completed output and valid synthetic Job/worker provenance; do not run a cloud model or hand-wave the registration.

Build one canonical manifest keyed by normalized relative path and pinned expected hash. Identical duplicate references produce one entry; conflicting hashes fail. Validate all entries before writing, preserve registered transcripts and the new PDF format support.

Handle unregistered transcript files explicitly as recovery/unpublished data, not silently trusted evidence. Reject symlink/reparse/path escape and unsupported manifest versions; never weaken restore's duplicate-entry rejection.
acceptance: Publish transcript -> backup -> restore -> reopen preserves each artifact, review and original hash. One archive entry per canonical path.

Duplicate malicious entries, conflicting hashes, traversal, unknown formats, wrong passphrase, truncated archive, and future unsupported format versions fail closed; valid legacy archives still restore.
tests: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test backup_artifacts
cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test journey
Add real registered-transcript round trip plus manifest uniqueness assertions. Windows reparse checks require Windows.

tasks.title: Bind citations to the actual historical extraction, end to end
tasks.problem: Schema 6 preserves extraction text, but read_text emits unversioned #L links and validate_citation checks active text. EvidenceLocator::Text verifies that an old revision exists, then validates its bounds against active text. The migration test merely downgrades user_version on a schema-6 database.
changes: Define one serialized versioned locator contract across Rust/TS. Validate range and excerpt against the specified immutable revision, never the active row. Keep navigation addresses distinct from evidentiary locators.
Stage as three reviewable slices: parser/resolver with compatibility tests; producers/search/agent/export adapters; renderer/copy/hover/history consumers. Preserve old IDs and extraction rows.

Recover legacy links from trustworthy recorded receipts/revisions only. Where the revision is not provable, label the link legacy/ambiguous; do not invent a backfill or silently retarget old evidence. Bound historical read payloads and report truncation.
Use a genuine schema-5 fixture with no extract_revisions table, then migrate/restore it. Keep full-transcript supersession and partial-no-clobber behavior.
acceptance: Old citation keeps exact old wording after new extraction, restart and backup/restore. Rev1-long/rev2-short remains valid for rev1; rev1-short/rev2-long cannot validate nonexistent rev1 lines.
New revisioned links work in chat, finding, record preview, search, hover, copy and export; wrong-case/source/revision/range rejects. Same fixture tests both Rust and TypeScript grammar.
tests: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test extract_revisions
cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test dossier
npm test; npm run build
Add migration and clickable historical-source integration tests; retain legacy fixtures.

tasks.title: Replace heuristic claim certification with structured publication
tasks.problem: content_tokens drops negation/numbers; any mapped citation or qualifier substring can bypass sentence coverage. Matching words is not matching a factual proposition. The new test explicitly accepts an unrelated instrument-log assertion carrying an existing citation.
changes: First remove heuristic-based certification: arbitrary free prose remains visibly unreviewed/partial rather than silently complete.

Add stable claim IDs/revisions and answer blocks with kind, claim references, versioned evidence and review stamp. Render reviewed factual wording from those blocks. New or materially edited factual wording creates a new assertion needing assessment, not a synonym threshold.

Separate observation, attributed statement, inference, hypothesis, limitation and next action. Block kind alone never certifies truth. Keep candidate/evidence-bound review, contrary evidence and human acceptance distinct.
Keep accessible plain-text output, but derive it from the same structured document. Do not impose a brittle substring rule on unrestricted prose.
acceptance: Negation, numeric changes, entity substitutions, short claims, decimal times, citation laundering, qualifier camouflage and mixed supported/unsupported blocks never inherit reviewed status.
Legitimate paraphrase can be proposed and assessed; editing it invalidates its stamp. Old free-text responses remain readable with truthful legacy status.
tests: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test dossier
Add adversarial final-publication tests including actual support-review stamp, not only gaps-string assertions.
npm test; npm run build; verify exported and displayed block status agree.

tasks.title: Finish usable, durable case consent and review controls
tasks.problem: Reopen/restore no longer overwrite permissions: preserve that fix. But settings and apply_app_settings still force online/text/images/auto/standard, and no visible direct-media opt-in exists in the inspected SettingsDialog.
changes: Separate app account/model availability from explicit case grants and selected review mode. New cases start local or use an explicitly confirmed creation policy; opening/settings/model selection never silently broadens grants.
Expose case text, images, original media, offline/emergency stop and review controls. Save precisely the choices shown. Preserve autonomous authorized work without per-tool confirmation spam.
Validate actual outgoing modalities against current policy; no forced image consent just to select a text-capable model. Keep credential storage outside case/renderer persistence.
Reconcile onboarding/README/settings copy and preserve the corrected context-removal behavior.
acceptance: Production command/UI journey: offline -> model availability -> case grant -> revoke -> restart -> restore keeps exact grants. Direct media can be deliberately enabled and revoked.
Saving a different model cannot downgrade challenge review or enable images. Revoke blocks future dispatch, with truthful in-flight transmission uncertainty.
tests: npm test; npm run build
cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test core
cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test master_v4
Native settings journey without the VISLEX_TEST_MODE bypass; record unavailable native checks explicitly.

tasks.title: Make automatic review state idempotent and revision-aware
tasks.problem: Completion now waits for task completion, but its fingerprint only identifies source hashes. New extraction/discovery outputs do not invalidate it. Completion audit is appended on every reconciliation; status may say complete for obsolete input and maps failures to planned.
changes: Use typed transition reasons, task/run epoch and an idempotent completion event. Fingerprint the actual evidence inputs/revisions and relevant processing coverage, excluding the review's own generated report to avoid perpetual invalidation.

Separate run finished from declared-checks complete, partial and human reviewed. Resume chat-preempted work without recreating the task, but never replay uncertain provider delivery or auto-restart user-stopped/error work.
Test cancellation/response/preemption interleavings through the real coordinator with a delayed synthetic transport. Surface paused reasons and newly available evidence explicitly.
acceptance: Repeated reconciliations emit one completion event. New transcript on same source invalidates currentness; own report publication does not endlessly trigger review.
Late old-run responses cannot restart or publish into a newer run. Failed and partial work remain distinguishable from complete.
tests: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test core
Add race, idempotence, same-source-revision and partial-completion tests using a controllable provider seam.

tasks.title: Fix palette, selection, citation navigation and draft export
tasks.problem: Palette activation lacks a result branch and pointer activation depends on stale state. Selection range can be replaced by lineStart; Ask can target an unmounted chat. Record preview citations are no-ops; dirty export uses saved text without a clear choice.
changes: Activate the passed item directly; route sources, records, search locators and commands through one typed navigation action. Keyboard and pointer must use the same function.
Preserve exact selected range/revision over generic viewport context. Switch to chat and attach before focusing. Keep skip attachment => null; it is not a source restriction.
Wire record-preview citations, show export saved revision or save-then-export, and protect tab/editor drafts from refresh and close. Do not silently upload draft text.
Add navigation history and keep source/time/page context across workspace switches.
acceptance: Pointer/Enter opens the same selected hit at correct historical locator. Selection in Evidence reaches Chat exactly once. No ignored clicks or accidental resubmission.
Export content matches the explicitly selected saved version; concurrent edits trigger a conflict rather than overwrite.
tests: npm test; npm run build
Add DOM-level interactions, not only standalone handler tests: palette click/Enter, Ask from Evidence, preview citation, dirty export and tab switching.

tasks.title: Separate cached browsing from strong integrity verification
tasks.problem: verify_source can reuse a hash cached by path, size and modification time. Same-size modification with preserved mtime can evade that cache. Read-only flags are not a complete tamper guarantee.
changes: Create explicitly named cached-interactive and full-byte verification APIs. Explicit Verify and protected publication pin content hashes with a fresh check outside long-held locks.

Verify opened file identity/containment and minimize path-replacement races; handle Windows junction/reparse points and same-size replacement. Never grant processing workers write access to originals.
Bound/clear caches by case/session and record verification method/time honestly. Recheck export review receipt identity, not only an accepted boolean, where exact-snapshot output is promised.
acceptance: A source modified in place with original size/mtime is rejected by explicit strong verification. Browsing remains fast without claiming a fresh hash.
Replacement/escape tests and export/backup integrity invariants pass; no original mutation or unrestricted file access.
tests: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test core
cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test backup_artifacts
Add platform-specific same-mtime and reparse adversarial fixtures; measure hash bytes and lock duration.

tasks.title: Introduce bounded case queries and case/session fences
tasks.problem: Full snapshots include all records and historical answers and are repeatedly polled. Commands/async results need explicit case/session identity; N+1 queries and quadratic frontend scans grow with case history.
changes: Add typed request envelopes and small case summary, paginated source/record/chat/job lists and explicit detail endpoints. Include case ID, session epoch, entity revision and event sequence.
Reject stale requests/results at the backend and renderer. Add targeted indexes verified with query plans; use keyset pagination where ordering is mutable.
Keep full reconciliation as bounded recovery, not perpetual broad polling. Do not leak restricted content through newly added query/search paths. Migrate consumers incrementally with contract tests.
acceptance: Late case-A response cannot replace case-B UI or mutate B. Lists have deterministic continuation and no duplicate/skipped entities under documented snapshot semantics.
Ordinary summary excludes full text/history; target <=256 KiB on defined large fixture. Measure actual latency and query count.
tests: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
npm test; npm run build
Seed large synthetic records; assert response bounds, page consistency, cross-case race rejection and SQL query-plan evidence.

tasks.title: Move heavy artifact publication outside the case mutex
tasks.problem: Processing itself often runs outside the mutex, but publication still copies/hashes large files while the case is locked.
changes: Separate authorize, produce, verify/stage, short transactional publish, and cleanup phases. Return verified artifact descriptors, not large byte buffers, to the DB owner.
Revalidate case/run epoch, policy, source hash and review/revision at commit. Persist an idempotent publication journal so crash after file write but before DB commit is recoverable.
Do not delete unknown orphan files automatically. Audit cleanup precisely and keep replay/cancellation responsive during multi-gigabyte publish.
acceptance: Synthetic large derivative publication does not block ordinary viewing/stop/settings on disk-copy duration. Record p50/p95/max lock spans; proposed p95 short-commit target <20 ms, subject to named reference hardware.
Crash injection at every boundary yields either fully registered immutable output or a recoverable unregistered output, never a false success.
tests: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
Publication fault injection, disk-full, cancellation-before-commit, case-close and duplicate-publish regressions.

tasks.title: Reuse a verified read-only recording lease instead of copying per minute
tasks.problem: OCR and overview schedule separate 60-second chunks; each worker job stages the entire recording. This creates file-size times chunk-count I/O amplification.
changes: Create a source-session lease keyed by source content/provenance and policy epoch. Workers receive read-only access to one verified private input and write access only to their own output directory.
Keep ownership/refcounts/crash cleanup explicit. Consider fusing overview/OCR decode only after lease correctness and identical timestamp/provenance tests.
Measure copies/hashes/launches/temporary bytes before and after. Do not use writable hardlinks, broad case ACL grants, or unrestricted persistent workers.
acceptance: Two-hour fixture no longer recopies the full original for each minute/pass; staged-input writes scale approximately with input size, with intentional exceptions reported.
Two simultaneous jobs cannot write each other's outputs or originals; cancellation, permission revocation and restart invalidate/release leases safely.
tests: Native packaged sandbox suite, serial tests plus explicit concurrency fixture
Instrumented discovery comparison on short/medium/large synthetic recordings; assert same PTS evidence mapping, not just faster time.

tasks.title: Unify interactive/background scheduling and cancellable resource limits
tasks.problem: Ad hoc kick loops and worker-slot waits obscure priority, cancellation, recovery and fairness.
changes: Use durable typed job states, priority, dependencies, input revision, heartbeat, attempt and cancel reason. One scheduler owns leases/resource permits; avoid a new distributed queue service.

Interactive page/seek work must not sit behind a long background batch forever. Resource waits themselves are cancellable. Resume checkpoints only with matching provenance; uncertain remote operations are not blindly retried.
Expose progress units and actionable retry/resume distinctions, disk capacity estimates and bounded crash reconciliation.
acceptance: Queued cancellation terminates without waiting for a busy worker. No duplicate running attempt after restart; background work is not starved by constant interactive input.
Stop latency, resource peak and scheduler fairness are measured under mixed tasks; native AppContainer boundaries retained.
tests: Deterministic scheduler tests with virtual clock and fake transport
Native simultaneous transcription/page/overview/cancel/sleep-resume journey.

tasks.title: Publish long transcripts as versioned segments and corrections
tasks.problem: Worker outputs can exceed the publisher's 1 MiB editable record limit. Polling retrieves whole transcripts repeatedly; model/profile reuse and corrections need distinct provenance.
changes: Persist immutable run/track/segment/word data with source/stream/container offsets, decoder gaps, model hash/options and timestamps. Provide bounded cursor queries and separate human corrections/review overlays.
Publish usable completed chunks transactionally without claiming whole-recording completion. Export long TXT/JSON/SRT by streaming; never silently truncate to fit a note.
Make profile upgrade/rerun explicit and provenance-aware. Preserve existing transcriptPlaybackLine offset handling; speaker turn proposals are not identity.
Avoid repeated global text-length sums and huge JSON rewrites; keep ASR boundary quality tests.
acceptance: >1 MiB synthetic transcript publishes/searches/exports without losing later segments. Correction cannot overwrite original machine wording or inherit review.
Multiple tracks, nonzero origins, silence, overlap, gaps and interrupted jobs preserve time mapping and declared coverage.
tests: Rust publication/integration tests using synthetic segment output
Python worker tests and real packaged short audio fixtures
Frontend segment pagination/follow-playback tests; large-run memory measurement.

tasks.title: Make search incremental, multimodal and read-fast
tasks.problem: Semantic search scans extraction lines, indexes at most 256 new passages during each query, parses JSON vectors and repeatedly looks up sources. Completion speed and searchable scope are unpredictable.
changes: Background-index exact extraction/segment revisions with deduped checkpoints. Use bounded semantic chunks with neighbor context; do not flatten away negations, speaker/track/time or document units.

Return immediate lexical results plus optional semantic results with index currentness. Include working products and video OCR as labeled distinct lead types; apply authorization before ranking and returning snippets.
Use measured typed vector storage/top-k and query plans rather than prematurely adding a vector server. Keep SQLite canonical, cached models case-safe, and historical evidence locators stable.
acceptance: Fresh full transcript becomes searchable independently of processing order. Query does not trigger full-case indexing or ask user to repeat search to finish indexing.
Target warm lexical p95 <250 ms on declared fixture/hardware; measure retrieval quality separately. No unsupported negative inference from zero hits.
tests: Search permission/order/revision/ranking fixtures
Worker embedding model and dimension contract tests
Measured cold/warm queries and wrong-person/negation/multimodal retrieval evaluation.

tasks.title: Make media controls exact about frames, tracks and lifecycle
tasks.problem: FRAME_STEP=1/30 is labeled one frame. MediaControls subscribes through a stable ref while the actual video node can be replaced by a proxy. Loop endpoints are not consistently validated.
changes: Label browser time stepping approximate; implement exact-frame inspection against decoded PTS with artifact citations. Pause on exact step and preserve actual source timing for VFR media.
Bind listeners to actual media element identity and initialize current metadata after mount/proxy replacement. Validate finite time/duration and A < B; respect keyboard events within inputs/selects.
Keep track/channel selection and source-relative/container-relative/incident time explicit. Preserve existing clock-fit/held-out review rules; never infer incident time from camera OCR.
Refresh a representative filmstrip incrementally rather than showing only the first cached samples forever.
acceptance: 24/30/60 fps and VFR fixtures step to correct decoded frames in exact mode. Original->proxy transition leaves play/time/mute/rate accurate.
A/B invalid order cannot trap playback. Transcript and accepted clock mapping seek correct source intervals.
tests: npm test; npm run build
Native original/proxy/VFR/track-offset/synchronized replay tests with known timestamps.

tasks.title: Make PDF and document navigation bounded and physically accurate
tasks.problem: The PDF viewer guesses a page count before metadata, stores one global aspect ratio, and conflates prefetch visibility with the current page. Page-copy links and evidentiary citations use inconsistent grammar.
changes: Probe actual page count and per-page geometry before scheduling. Move requests out of React state updaters into the scheduler. Bound rendered pages/cache and cancel obsolete requests.
Separate prefetch from visible-page tracking. Reject zero/negative/out-of-range page input without launching workers; preserve printed labels versus physical page numbers.

Keep native text, OCR and rendered page references separate. Handle office formatting limitations visibly; use linear row iteration for XLSX formula/cached value pairs rather than repeated read-only random cell lookups.
Add malformed/huge/empty/rotated/mixed-page fixtures without unrestricted parsing or document macros.
acceptance: One-page PDF produces no page-12 errors; mixed landscape/portrait geometry remains correct; current context reflects visible page not prefetch.
Copied page navigation works or explicitly yields a navigation-only link; evidence citations point to supported original/derivative units.
tests: Frontend page-count/visibility/navigation tests
Python document-format fixtures and native rendering/cancellation checks
Large-PDF bounded memory and worker-launch count measurement.

tasks.title: Normalize frontend state and stream without dropping content
tasks.problem: Broad snapshots and whole-list rendering recreate work; live text slices the last 64000 characters; in-memory drafts need case-scoped lifecycle. Global busy state and nonreactive context can get stale.
changes: Use a small normalized case-scoped store with selectors and explicit operation state. Virtualize long sources/transcripts/actions/messages and incrementally parse completed markdown blocks plus streaming tail.
Persist/receive the full answer while rendering a bounded window; never delete the beginning of a streamed response. Batch display updates without losing receipts.
Subscribe to viewer context reactively; isolate drafts by case/entity/revision, protect conflicts, and define deliberate crash-recovery/privacy policy. No case text in browser storage by convenience.
Characterize before splitting App/ui/coordinator components; no framework swap or universal abstraction spree.
acceptance: Answer >64 KiB retains beginning and citations. 10000-source/long-transcript fixture remains interactive with bounded DOM nodes.
Case switch, tab switch, new server revision and failed save cannot erase draft or mutate another case. Visual selection is stable while jobs refresh.
tests: npm test; npm run build
DOM integration, render-count profiling, stream completion and draft-conflict fixtures
Measure interaction p95; target cached interactions <100 ms on specified reference machine.

tasks.title: Unify findings, witness comparison and legal work products
tasks.problem: Existing workbench already has discrepancies, hypotheses, coverage, clocks and product launchers. Building another parallel case-analysis system would waste work and create competing truth stores.
changes: Enhance those existing entities with usable structured forms and one shared source inspector. Preserve raw provenance view. Add witness statement comparison, evidence/issue matrix, production-gap tracking and exhibit preparation as thin views over current versioned records.
Separate inconsistency, omission, changed account, uncertain clock and extraction error. Show both sides and discriminating next check; never translate disagreement into a deception verdict.

Pin jurisdiction/relevant date/authority provenance; identify treatment as unchecked unless actually checked. Add jurisdiction adapters only with allowlisted primary sources and tests, not arbitrary browsing from evidence.
Use dependency-aware staleness rather than marking every unrelated record stale; preserve human decisions per exact revision.
acceptance: Lawyer can reach original source, compare two accounts, record an accepted finding and generate a traceable draft without editing opaque JSON.
Existing replay/hypothesis/product behavior remains available; unsupported facts/authorities remain unknown rather than filled in.
tests: Rust work-product/dossier/authority contract tests
Native end-to-end witness comparison -> exact source -> finding -> draft -> review/export journey.

tasks.title: Verify redaction coordinates and disclosure-package boundaries
tasks.problem: Flattened redaction and page-specific human approval exist; visual masks alone do not establish sanitized bytes. Normal dossier bundles intentionally include cited evidence and are not disclosure-safe packages.
changes: Preserve the existing gate and verify top-left coordinates under zoom/rotation/EXIF/physical page geometry. Render-compare and inspect output structures for hidden text, attachments, metadata and original inclusion.
Treat archive, reviewed work product and sanitized derivative as separate export types with previews/manifests and explicit scope. Review approval binds exact output hash and pages.
Use per-page streaming/resource disposal for large PDFs. Never auto-approve hidden/sensitive-content discovery or claim every sensitive region was found.
acceptance: Known secret text/images cannot be extracted from the reviewed derivative; original remains untouched privately. Wrong-page/rotated boxes fail or map correctly.
Revoked review, changed hash and unreviewed page block export. Backup/restore still handles resulting PDF artifacts.
tests: Native redaction visual/structure fixtures plus backup round trip
Worker bounds/cancellation/multipage tests and reviewer hash-binding tests.

tasks.title: Harden provider capability and streaming contracts
tasks.problem: Catalogue filtering is not capability validation; adapters differ in streaming and native protocol state. Configured reasoning/routing and usage uncertainty need explicit contracts.
changes: Reuse managed HTTP clients, support provider-specific stream parsing, preserve native tool/reasoning signature state, and distinguish transport failure/refusal/truncation/completion.

Define tested model capabilities, finite context/output assumptions, modality limits and supported reasoning controls from current official documentation. Probe with synthetic content only and do not send real case data merely to test a model.

Add bounded request budgets/context compaction and progress-aware loop recovery without silently changing chosen quality model. Respect user's no arbitrary application spending cap preference; expose usage and cancellation.
Team assignments return scoped evidence packets, not votes. Verify permitted inputs and stale outputs at merge; do not leak other case context.
acceptance: Synthetic contracts cover every enabled adapter, multiple tool calls, malformed chunks, reconnect/cancel and uncertain billing without duplicate actions.
Streaming is truthful per provider; unsupported features are disabled with a reason rather than guessed from a name.
tests: Rust synthetic provider protocol/permission/team suites
Optional expressly authorized live synthetic account probes recorded separately; no client evidence in fixtures.

tasks.title: Validate subscription ACP as an optional isolated integration
tasks.problem: A coding subscription is not automatically an API allowance. This is optional and must not block core-app fixes or quietly bypass evidence restrictions.
changes: Revalidate current official Codex/adapter and Gemini subscription authentication/capability support before writing an adapter. Do not assume earlier research still applies; distinguish OpenAI official runtime from any third-party ACP bridge.
Use a constrained stdio/ACP boundary with explicit case projection, narrowly authorized tools, lifecycle/cancel/credential hygiene and no arbitrary workspace or network escalation.
Keep a compatible documented path as a small optional adapter. Where unavailable, report a specific compatibility blocker; do not scrape browser tokens, spoof clients or substitute a hidden API bill.
MCP remains deferred. Z.ai used to code VisLex is separate from VisLex runtime provider selection.
acceptance: Supported path is tested with synthetic evidence, scoped permissions, cancellation and no API fallback without consent.
Unsupported subscription paths remain clearly unsupported, not marked completed. Core release can proceed without this optional task.
tests: Current official-doc compatibility report and adapter protocol tests
Authorized account-auth synthetic integration test; never include credentials in logs or commits.

tasks.title: Polish the existing design system and accessibility
tasks.problem: The new token theme/workspace rail is a usable foundation, not a reason for another redesign. Visual polish must correspond to working controls and readable evidence.
changes: Keep Ink & Evidence colors/semantic roles. Introduce resizable/collapsible panes, comfortable/compact density, consistent type/space tokens, visible focus and accessible labels/shortcuts.
Design every key workspace in empty/loading/partial/failure/ready/locked states. Surface stage-specific progress, retry meaning, source identity and uncertainty instead of decorative dashboards.
Test light/dark at Surface-sized 1366x768 and 1920x1080, 125/150/200 percent scale, long filenames, long chat and reduced motion. Preserve original media colors.
Use DOM/a11y checks plus real screenshots reviewed by a human or vision-capable reviewer; GLM-5.3 is documented text-only. No screenshot pass claim from DOM existence alone.
acceptance: Every primary control is reachable by keyboard, focus is restored after modal/menu close and no panel becomes unusably narrow. No clipped core action at reference sizes.
Contrast, touch target and screen-reader checks documented; visual regression references and interaction results retained.
tests: Frontend interaction and accessibility suite
Native screenshot matrix plus manual/vision review and reduced-motion/keyboard checklist.

tasks.title: Measure evidence quality and human review effort
tasks.problem: Synthetic scorer success does not establish real evidence quality or superiority to a competitor. Speech/frame extraction and derived claims have different error types.
changes: Create separate development and held-out synthetic/authorized deidentified incidents with human-checked ground truth, preserving source/clock/track ambiguity. Test retrieval, attribution, material fact recall, unsupported claims, false contradiction and coverage honesty.

Measure human verification time, cost, runtime and recovery together. Sound candidates stay unclassified unless a separately evaluated classifier supports a scoped label; no invented confidence or identity.
Use paired incident-level comparisons with uncertainty, not the same model voting its own answers correct. Keep sensitive evidence outside repository/CI.
acceptance: Versioned benchmark protocol and actual results exist with limitations and reviewer provenance. Numeric release thresholds are fixed before viewing held-out results.
No marketing claim of 99 percent accuracy or best-in-market without relevant independent comparative data.
tests: python -m unittest discover -s benchmarks -p test_*.py
python -m unittest discover -s workers -p test_*.py
Held-out adjudication run with environment/model/input revisions and reproducible output capture.

tasks.title: Close security, privacy and untrusted-input boundaries
tasks.problem: More tools, concurrency and data pathways increase scope-bypass and prompt-injection risks. A source document is untrusted data, never permission to execute commands or transmit secrets.
changes: Review every command/tool entry point and publication path with a permission matrix; test restricted derived records, prior chat, team outputs, search, restored cases and capability URLs.

Inject malicious document/tool text and filenames into synthetic fixtures; assert it cannot expand filesystem/network/tool scope or mark human approval. Verify AppContainer no-network/no-original-write and parent-case separation.

Review CSP/custom protocol origin/range behavior, debug-only bypasses, key/log/dump handling and case metadata retention. Diagnostics must be opt-in and scrubbed; do not claim local storage is encrypted when only backups are.
Cache/worker optimizations cannot weaken these invariants.
acceptance: Complete command/tool authorization matrix and negative tests; no unauthorized case content in outbound captures or logs.
Residual threat model and any external-review requirements stated plainly. No production test override accidentally shipped.
tests: Native sandbox and authorization integration suites
Prompt-injection, race/revocation, restricted-derivation, path and protocol adversarial tests
Dependency/secret scans with tool versions and results recorded.

tasks.title: Make the packaged Windows build reproducible and diagnosable
tasks.problem: Latest CI did not start a runner, and ordinary tests do not exercise the packaged worker/native interface. Model/runtime provenance includes more than one EXE hash.
changes: Resolve infrastructure through authorized account controls only; preserve exact no-run evidence. Add separate fast checks and native/package gates after a runner is available, not a fake green fallback.

Pin/check runtime, model, DLL and worker manifests; distinguish first build downloads from offline runtime. Validate missing/corrupt model, unsupported CPU/architecture and first-run dependency errors.
Produce commit-tagged installer/portable artifact hashes, SBOM/notices and a deliberate signing/update strategy. Never commit keys, live cases or large generated packages into source.
Make support diagnostics local/scrubbed, restore demonstrable on a clean second machine and failed builds leave actionable receipts.
acceptance: Clean Windows checkout builds exact package and passes intended packaged-worker and native acceptance. Restart, migration and second-machine restore documented.
No unsigned preview is described as production-certified. Network/resource/model failures are explicit and recoverable.
tests: Existing verification and native-acceptance scripts after reading their prerequisites
Clean Windows 11 x64 install/build/run journey; explicit supported ARM/emulation boundary
Package manifest/license/hash validation and offline launch test.

tasks.title: Release gate: complete protected journey under realistic load
tasks.problem: A count of completed coding tickets does not establish a reliable evidence application.
changes: Run import -> processing -> exact search -> historical original navigation -> cited finding -> review -> pinned export -> encrypted backup -> restore -> reopen, on the packaged build.
Use 25-file/1-GB, 250-file/10-GB and 1000-plus-file/40-60-GB synthetic case tiers; name hardware, commit, model/runtime versions and peak disk/RAM. These are test targets, not existing measurements.

Include abrupt exit, power/sleep interruption, disk full, cancelled jobs, revoked permission, late results, malformed evidence and old-schema cases. Consolidate docs so preview limitations and accepted release capabilities cannot conflict.

Review every uninspected tracked source/config/test path in the generated inventory; generated/binary paths require provenance/content-specific checks. Optional ACP R20 is not a core-release prerequisite.
acceptance: All mandatory gates have evidence; blocked/not-run remains blocked/not-run. Independent review signs off actual tested scope, not claims of perfection.
No data loss, silent citation retargeting, unauthorized transmission or false human approval in the protected journey. Performance/quality outcomes meet predeclared measured thresholds.
tests: Full frontend, Rust, Python, packaged sandbox/native, migration, export, backup/restore, accessibility and held-out evaluation suites
Final diff, documentation, coverage-register and secret/license review on the exact candidate commit.
